RC4 connects optional JEV decisions to normal development commands and keeps the coding model fixed by default.

- Provider submissions deliver mandatory guidance and bounded, source-linked optional context before
  the model reads. Terminal check status is compact by default; `--full` and `check-output` retain
  access to complete evidence. Code preserves failures, required guidance, native status and cleanup.
- Opt-in question sets add requirement-linked change, test and completion advice. Existing RC3
  question defaults remain unchanged. Local and remote CI can use scenario descriptions, declared
  coverage and limits; comparison reads existing matching results and never runs or skips extra checks.
- Optional category routing maps a classified task to one operator-selected model/effort pair. One
  bounded read-only Claude class uses trusted admission, restricted tools, source roots, fresh native
  qualification and explicit continuation authority. Unknown, missing-token and unqualified choices
  keep the fixed pair. Existing project model-selection prose is preserved for deliberate review.
- Caller telemetry records delivered evidence, actual JEV transport attempts, fallback/off states,
  native model usage and exact outcome links. Unknown use and off-entry activity remain unknown.
  Even with inference off, governed entry points write bounded local exposure receipts; no model call
  or cloud disclosure follows from that accounting. Restricted Claude jobs disable the host's otherwise unnecessary session-title model call.
- Apple dependency approvals retain their work ID through detached checks. Exact terminal check-reader
  reconciliation is supported. Declared Android emulator adapters can refuse installs on insufficient
  or unknown storage and retain resource ownership until target, ports and adapter locks are absent.

Adopt deliberately. All new question sets and category routing require explicit configuration;
no JEV account is needed for normal operation. Requiring governed admission is a separate opt-in
from routing activation. A package upgrade does not install machine-wide provider policy, rewrite
project-owned model choices or migrate an adopter's device recipes automatically.
Only new hash-bound RC4 policy-refusal receipts receive the capability exemption. If a job root
contains older unmarked failures, qualify the fixed pair again after those failures; do not rewrite
the old receipts or assume an earlier successful qualification remains current.

Native qualification is limited to the tested restricted Claude child class. The unrestricted parent
is outside enforcement coverage. Requested effort is retained when native effort readback is absent.
Deterministic caller/installed fixtures establish integration; live JEV classification and accepted-work
benefit still need ordinary development telemetry. Required checks, merge authority, app repair and
release actions remain deterministic. Physical-device removal tests and broader platform qualification
remain deferred. This release makes no token-savings or whole-session containment claim.
